0022600101.text: The Grizzlies come into this game 1-0 after a home win, sitting 2nd in the Southwest and 3rd in the West, but Isaiah Stewart is out with an ankle injury. The Warriors have not played a 2026-27 game yet, and Brandin Podziemski (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery) are all out for Golden State. The Grizzlies lost 0-3 to the Warriors in the 2025-26 season series, including a 133-112 defeat in Memphis on February 25, 2026, and no games have been played yet this season between the teams.
